description.value: A commercial resort campground at the gateway to Wells Gray Park, offering tent sites with access to an on-site pool and summer restaurant; a convenient base for exploring 250+ waterfalls and park activities, though the fenced, gated resort setting trades wilderness feel for amenity comfort.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active multi-accommodation resort at 373 Clearwater Valley Rd with phone 250-674-3909, corroborating OSM address. Tent sites and RV camping are explicitly listed, confirming the camp_site classification. An on-site family restaurant is described in the front-page copy, and booking buttons throughout the site confirm reservations are accepted online.
concerns: OSM operator tag is 'KOA' but the website makes no mention of KOA affiliation anywhere; this tag may be outdated or incorrect.
Phone number 250-674-3909 is confirmed on the website but was absent from OSM tags — added from website source.
The /about-us/ subpage contains Lorem ipsum placeholder text, suggesting the site is partially unmaintained, though core booking and contact pages appear functional.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active campground and resort at the Wells Gray Park gateway offering tent sites, RV hookups, and cabins — a clear fit for touring cyclists needing overnight accommodation with on-site food service along the North Thompson route.

wow_evidence: gateway to Wells Gray Park, offering tent sites with access to an on-site pool and summer restaurant
